title: CyFj11 validation suite: synthetic test workspaces, FCS files, and analysis scripts for FlowJo v11 / R interoperability
description:
This dataset contains the structured validation materials for the R/Bioconductor package CyFj11, which enables import of FlowJo v11 workspaces into R GatingSet objects and export to the FlowJo v10 XML format.

Contents:
- 14 test scenarios (test01/ to test14/): each directory contains FCS files, CyFj11-exported FlowJo v10 workspaces (*_export.wsp), and comparison copies (*_export.llm.wsp).
- Synthetic FCS data for tests 01-13, generated programmatically from normal and log-normal distributions with fixed random seeds using generate_all_tests.R.
- Public example data for test 14: the FlowSOM Bioconductor package example files 68983.fcs and gating.wsp, retrieved automatically from system.file("extdata", ..., package = "FlowSOM").
- Regeneration scripts: generate_all_tests.R and generate_test13.R.
- Validation records: validation_counts.csv, validation_counts.tsv, validation_transforms.tsv, and history.txt.

Data provenance:
- Tests 01-13: entirely synthetic; no human or patient-derived material.
- Test 14: public example dataset from the Bioconductor FlowSOM package (GPL >= 2).

Related software:
- CyFj11: https://github.com/baj12/CyFj11
- FlowSOM: https://bioconductor.org/packages/FlowSOM
notes: Test 14 FCS and workspace files are redistributed from the public example data of the Bioconductor FlowSOM package (GPL >= 2). All other files are original and synthetic.
